_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Uko kama Mwari {player_id} katika Tic Tac Toe.
Lengo lako ni kushinda tatu mfululizo (kulia, wima, au diagonal) kwenye kibao.
Wakati wa mpango wako, unapaswa kuchagua nambari ya mraba (0-8) unapotaka kuweka alama yako inayofuata.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' inaweka alama yako katikati ya kibao.
Kama Mwari {player_id}, utakuwa '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si ikinyenyeri kibereye. Gikwiye kuba kiri hagati ya 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Mwari {player_id} alitumia alama yake ({symbol}) kwenye seli {cell}.
